heading.title: Boost Your Earnings — Refer & Earn!

refer.title: How It Works
refer.instruction: You can only have one account and you can not refer yourself!

step1.title: Invite Your Friends
step1.description: Tell your friends about ProfitPiller and share your referral link on social media, chats, or anywhere you like.

step2.title: Share Your Bonus Code
step2.description: When new users redeem your bonus code within 24 hours of signing up, they become your referral and enjoy a 10% bonus for their first 24 hours.

step3.title: Receive Your Commission
step3.description: Earn a 10% commission on all the survey rewards your referrals earn — for life. Don’t worry, their earnings stay the same — your rewards are on us!

heading.subtitle: Enter your bonus code below to receive a 10% bonus valid for 24 hours.
heading.title: Redeem Bonus Code

extra.step1_d: Codes come from a friend's invite, our emails and notifications, and special promotions.
extra.step2_d: Type or paste the code and tap Redeem. Each code works once per account.
extra.step3_d: For the next 24 hours every approved survey and offer pays 10% more.
extra.find_notify_d: New codes and limited-time boosts arrive as alerts.
extra.find_friend_d: Every member has an invite code - start with a friend's code.
extra.find_share_d: Invite friends and earn a commission on what they complete.
extra.use_title: Make the most of your bonus
extra.use_offers_d: Games and app offers with big rewards
extra.use_streak_d: Come back every day and climb the leaderboard
extra.tip: Tip: redeem a code right before a survey session so the 24-hour bonus covers as many completions as possible.
